semanticRules.defaultOwnedParameterMode: consume-by-value; rt take optional when move already required
semanticRules.blockingRegion: T or void; suspend logical continuation when waiting; never OS-carrier blocking
semanticRules.nonblockingRegion: Future<T> or Future<void>; not Channel or Stream
semanticRules.gpuToCpu: fence; host continuation; no CPU callback on SIMT lane
semanticRules.cpuToGpu: device capability admission and typed kernel launch
semanticRules.residency: HostBuffer and GpuBuffer are disjoint; explicit upload/download
semanticRules.deviceWork: no implicit CPU fallback, unsupported backend rejects
semanticRules.deviceLifetime: generational ownership and true completion fence required before reuse/retirement
semanticRules.graphDependencies: ordered acyclic; operands reference prior typed SSA nodes
semanticRules.stage: compiler reference graph only; runtime actor ownership/device fence proof pending
